description: Multimodal breakthroughs with CLIP and DALL-E, Codex and Copilot invent AI coding, instruction tuning (FLAN, T0) invents the ChatGPT recipe, and AlphaFold 2 open release transforms biology.

events.title: Anthropic founded by ex-OpenAI safety team
events.summary: Seven-plus OpenAI leads incorporated Anthropic as a Public Benefit Corp in January 2021 in San Francisco to build steerable, interpretable robust systems. Stealth until $124M raise May 28, 2021 led by Jaan Tallinn, Moskovitz and Schmidt, it became OpenAI's chief alignment rival and Claude maker.
events.significance: Second frontier lab; origin of Constitutional AI and the Claude lineage.

events.title: CLIP plus DALL-E 1 announced
events.summary: OpenAI debuted two multimodal Transformers: CLIP (400M image-text contrastive, zero-shot ResNet-50 parity) with full paper, and DALL-E (12B GPT-3 generating images from text like avocado armchair) with blog plus February paper. They proved natural-language supervision plus scale yields zero-shot vision and creative generation, birthing prompt engineering for images.
events.significance: Birth of text-to-image as language modeling; CLIP becomes the evaluator for all later image work.

events.title: Switch Transformer scales to trillion parameters
events.summary: Fedus, Zoph and Shazeer simplified MoE to top-1 routing, enabling 1.6T-parameter sparse models with 7x pretraining speedup over T5 at same FLOPs. It broke the trillion-parameter barrier first and validated conditional compute, leading to GLaM and later Mixtral-style MoEs.
events.significance: Sparse scaling path that returns in 2023-2024 with Mixtral and GPT-4 rumors.

events.title: Margaret Mitchell fired from Google Ethical AI
events.summary: Co-lead Margaret Mitchell was fired after a 5-week suspension for using scripts to find evidence of discrimination against Gebru; Google cited code-of-conduct violations. It followed Jeff Dean's apology memo the same day. With Gebru gone, the Ethical AI team collapsed, prompting reorg under Marian Croak.
events.significance: Second act of the Google ethics crisis; deepened mistrust between researchers and management.

events.title: On the Dangers of Stochastic Parrots published
events.summary: Bender, Gebru, McMillan-Major and Mitchell asked How big is too big on environmental cost, bias and accountability of ever-larger LMs like BERT and GPT-3. Published at FAccT after Gebru's firing, it framed the 2021 scale-vs-safety debate. Same day the US NSCAI urged massive AI funding to compete with China.
events.significance: Most-cited critique of scale; intellectual anchor for 2023 pause debates.

events.significance: Ecosystem shift from papers to shared weights.

events.significance: Vision Transformer made practical for detection and segmentation.

events.title: EU proposes AI Act (first comprehensive AI law)
events.summary: The Commission published the 108-article AI Act proposal with 4-tier risk system (unacceptable, high, limited, minimal), banning social scoring and real-time biometric ID while imposing conformity duties on high-risk hiring and medical systems. First-ever horizontal AI regulation, it started a 3-year path to 2024 adoption.
events.significance: Regulatory track that becomes law in 2024 and enforced in 2025-2026.

events.significance: Showed ViTs learn objects without supervision.

events.title: FLAN: Finetuned Language Models Are Zero-Shot Learners
events.summary: Instruction-tuning a 137B LaMDA-PT on 60+ NLP tasks phrased as instructions beat zero-shot 175B GPT-3 on 20 of 25 tasks and even few-shot on ANLI and BoolQ. Posted Sept 3, ICLR 2022, it invented instruction tuning alongside T0, directly leading to FLAN-T5, InstructGPT comparisons and the ChatGPT instruction paradigm.
events.significance: Recipe breakthrough that makes ChatGPT possible: teach the model to follow instructions.

events.title: Gopher 280B plus RETRO 7.5B plus ethical risks taxonomy
events.summary: DeepMind's trio: Gopher 280B on MassiveText evaluated on 152 tasks showing scale helps comprehension but not logic; RETRO 7.5B retrieving 2T tokens matching Gopher with updatable memory; and a 21-risk taxonomy paper. It argued retrieval beats sheer scale and deeply analyzed bias, directly leading to Chinchilla and Sparrow.
events.significance: Sets up 2022's Chinchilla correction and retrieval revival (RAG).
